## Uncertainty-aware interpretation
The estimates are descriptive normal-approximation pilot summaries, not formal proof. Overlapping small-sample upper-tail behavior means no cell is promoted on a single maximum.

## Decision
B. Run a third-stage pilot because two or more cells remain competitive.

## Next intended action
Design P009 only after reviewing P008; do not start a full 10,000-candidate experiment from P008 alone.
